notes.title: TimeK1.0.5 Release
notes.notes:
[h3]TimeK1.0.5 has been released.[/h3]

[list]
[*]Added a message that allows recovery by rewinding when approaching the time limit.
[*]Added a message that the ability to rewind a few seconds when failed can also be accessed from the menu.
[*]Fixed some text issues.
[*]Fixed a bug where an effect would occur when rewinding to 0 seconds using Reverse.
[/list]

notes.title: We have unlocked the demo version up to Stage 13.
notes.notes:
Today, we have updated the TimeK Demo to version 1.0.3a.

With this update, you can now play without restrictions up to Stage 13.

For those who are playing TimeK for the first time, reaching Stage 13 will likely take a significant amount of time. If you are unsure about making a purchase, why not give it a try and play until Stage 13?

Stage 13, in particular, is one that I personally enjoy. It takes place in a dimly lit cave, and you progress through its challenges.
